method: Direct interaction and screenshots through the managed Chrome browser. This is an observed manual QA record, separate from Node, VM and native-reference evidence.

confirmed.result: 100 nF baseline and 220 nF changed-capacitor runs completed with 501 raw points; magnitude/phase overlay visible.
Parameter undo and redo created new revisions and clearly marked older results outdated.
Arrow-key move, toolbar rotation, inspector mirror and refresh preserved C1 electrical connections. Subsequent endpoint-routing fix visually reviewed and computed successfully.
Delete R1-C1 wire -> Failed with R1 pin 2 unconnected. Enter on both pins in Wire mode restored the wire and a fresh 501-point AC run.
Two independent dividers measured 5 V / 2 V with 8 connections. An explicit junction at the crossing produced 3.5 V / 3.5 V with 10 connections. Undo restored 5 V / 2 V with 8 connections.
Original QA middle-dot title failed upstream byte-offset parsing. Adapter 2 rerun with unchanged Unicode title completed with 5 V / 2 V.
Transient requested at 100 us duration / 1 ns maximum step; Stop produced Cancelled with worker termination. Subsequent AC run completed with 501 points.
Imported a 10 V/two-10-kohm divider from a .cir file into a netlist workspace and computed 5 V. No schematic reconstruction was presented.
Browser JSON download, chooser import, replacement, refresh recovery and final revision-7/501-point round trip passed. Imported-results provenance notice was visible.
Downloaded 502 lines: header plus 501 rows, frequency plus twelve real/imaginary trace columns; no display decimation in numerical export.
A 114.8 Hz, B 1.622 kHz, delta 1.507 kHz; output magnitude difference -488.5 mV displayed.
Dark, light and high-contrast screenshots reviewed.

Same-origin iframe widths 390 px (375 px client area with scrollbar) and 768 px. No document horizontal overflow; inspector editing, Values/plots and panel toggles accessible. Phone-width change 220 nF -> 330 nF completed another 501-point AC run.
Exact build copied beneath /qa/circuitbench/. App, module worker and WASM loaded; fresh Unicode-title OP run returned 5 V / 2 V.

Browser-generated report contained immutable circuit/configuration, numerical plots with named legend, raw evidence metadata, model/engine identification, interpretation and logs. Exact HTML independently rendered and reviewed; see report-layout.json.

unverified.workflow: Browser offline reload and update activation
unverified.reason: The managed non-localhost HTTP origin is not a secure context, so service-worker registration cannot be tested here. VM logic and bundled assets are separately verified.

unverified.workflow: Standalone HTML report and .cir download events
unverified.reason: Controls ran and status changed; no completed download was observed. JSON and CSV downloads did work. Cause unresolved; no browser-policy cause is asserted.

unverified.reason: The browser-generated HTML was rendered with WeasyPrint, not the native Chrome print dialog.

unverified.workflow: Physical touch devices and other browser engines
unverified.reason: Responsive checks were constrained desktop-Chrome viewports, not physical mobile/tablet hardware or Safari/Firefox.

releaseDecision: Remain 1.0.0-rc.1; do not promote until required browser offline and remaining output checks are actually verified.
